{
"templateId": "616fb00d-e58e-5578-bfe6-01f5ab99768c",
"title": "Build Retirement Income Plan Checklist",
"text": "Complete these checks before presenting a retirement income plan:\n\n- Confirm planned retirement timing, employment status, and expected lifestyle changes.\n- Verify essential spending, discretionary spending, one-time goals, and emergency reserve needs.\n- Inventory income sources, including Social Security, pensions, annuities, rental income, part-time income, and portfolio withdrawals.\n- Review account types and tax character across taxable, tax-deferred, Roth, HSA, and cash reserves.\n- Model withdrawal sequencing and identify tax‑aware distribution opportunities.\n- Check Medicare, health insurance, long‑term care, and insurance premium assumptions.\n- Review required minimum distribution timing where applicable.\n- Evaluate inflation assumptions and stress‑test market downturn scenarios.\n- Confirm beneficiary designations and estate planning coordination items.\n- Document open questions, missing evidence, and recommended next steps for advisor review.\nUpdate the model for Galen Thimblefern with survivor income, Medicare premiums, cash reserves, and revised withdrawal assumptions.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-12-06",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For the retirement income model refresh, Tobin’s review showed the spending file still included Rhea’s employer medical premiums and income, so updated survivor income, Medicare premiums, cash reserves, and portfolio withdrawal assumptions were identified as inputs for the next plan version; the agreed follow‑up is due 2024-12-06."
},
{
"templateId": "ec95858f-0b1b-5ac5-9396-1be6809f1ffc",
"title": "Review Concentrated Position Exposure",
"text": "Assess position size, cost basis, holding period, tax impact, liquidity needs, employer or insider restrictions, diversification targets, and available sale, hedge, gifting, or charitable strategies for Galen Thimblefern's holding of Moonbadger Industrial Systems stock, focusing on staged sale options, charitable gifting, and tax‑impact review.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-12-13",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For Moonbadger Industrial Systems position analysis, Galen asked for a staged sale, charitable gifting, and tax‑impact review because the holding remains a large part of the taxable account and he does not want a rushed decision during estate administration; the agreed follow‑up is due 2024-12-13."
}
]
